originals.ko: 나는 내 이름을 바꾸지 않을 거야
나는 웨일스어로 내 이름을 쓰고 싶어
나는 내 이름을 바꾸고 싶었어, 하지만 나는 확실하지 않아
문제없어, 나는 지금 내 이름을 쓸 거야

topups.why: The Welsh fragment 'ond ddim yn ...' has no subject, and the Korean '하지만 아주 특이하지 않은' is unnatural Korean that doesn't clearly point to that fragment.
The Welsh starts with no subject and no 'dydy'. A learner given '아주 특이하지 않지만 흥미로워' would reasonably say 'dydy o ddim yn anarferol iawn ond mae'n ddiddorol', so there are two possible answers.

topups.ko: 나는 상관없어, 왜냐하면 그건 아주 특이하지 않으니까

topups.why: Five stronger USE rows are already kept. 그게 (o) and 그건 (hynna) are too easy to mix up across neighbouring rows.
The Korean has no subject, so it could be 'dydy o' or 'dydy hynna'. Elsewhere this course uses 그건 for hynna, so the answer is not unique.
